title: Can Predominant Credible Information Suppress Misinformation in Crises? Empirical Studies of Tweets Related to Prevention Measures during COVID-19
reasoning: The paper conducts an empirical study on the relationship between credible information and misinformation regarding public health measures (wearing masks, social distancing) during the COVID-19 pandemic. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a component of its research.
